_about: Copy this file into src/content.local/ (a gitignored directory) to get a REVIEW build: the reserved photo places draw their measured shot-cards, so a preview shows the geometry a real photograph will take. Nothing tracked may turn a placeholder on - `npm run check:content` fails any built page carrying a data-placeholder fill, so this cannot reach the apex. Files in that directory deep-merge over src/content.json in filename order (src/lib/content.ts).
_run: npm run review:render   # it plants this overlay, builds, ASSERTS the shot-cards are really in the page, runs the geometry gates with every tracked report redirected to .design/tmp-review/, then removes the overlay and rebuilds. By hand it is slower and easy to leave half-done; if you do it by hand, send check:ground/check:area their GROUND_OUT/AREA_OUT scratch paths so a tracked report never describes a review page, and finish with: rm -rf src/content.local && npm run build
